abstract: PURPOSE: Testicular microlithiasis (TM) is a relatively rare condition characterized by calcific concref1p4 within the seminiferous tubules. Little has been reported on the incidence or the clinical implication of TM among Japanese. To address the problem, we evaluated pathologic specimens from biopsies and orchiectomies, of testes with various conditions. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Pathologic specimens of the testes of 200 cases, 56 from orchiectomy and 144 from testicular biopsy, were investigated. RESULTS: The pathological diagnosis of TM was confirmed in seven (3.5%) cases, four of which were associated with germ cell tumors and the other three were obtained from testicular biopsies performed for examination of infertile men. Of the 41 patients with germ cell tumors, four (9.8%) were found to have TM, and another three (2.5%) were identified among 122 patients with infertility. The prevalence of TM is significantly higher in specimen with germ cell tumors than those without germ cell tumors (p < 0.05). CONCLUSIONS: Although TM is rarely encountered, this condition is relatively often accompanied by testicular malignancy. Further investigation would be fundamental to ascertain the relationship between TM and testicular malignancy.
abstract_ja: 目的：精巣微小石灰化（TM）は、精細管内に石灰化物が沈着する比較的まれな病態である。日本人におけるTMの頻度や臨床的意義に関する報告は少ない。この問題を検討するため、様々な病態の精巣について、生検および精巣摘除術による病理標本を評価した。方法：精巣病理標本200例（精巣摘除術56例、精巣生検144例）を検討した。結果：TMの病理学的診断は7例（3.5%）で確認された。そのうち4例は胚細胞腫瘍を伴っており、他の3例は不妊症の男性に対して行われた精巣生検から得られた。胚細胞腫瘍を有する41例中4例（9.8%）にTMが認められ、不妊症患者122例中3例（2.5%）にも認められた。TMの頻度は、胚細胞腫瘍を有する標本において、そうでない標本と比べて有意に高かった（p < 0.05）。結論：TMはまれにしか認められないが、精巣悪性腫瘍を高頻度に伴う。TMと精巣悪性腫瘍の関係を明らかにするには、さらなる検討が必要である。
